text: Before I attempt to answer your question, "why would I ever want to use Effect?" I'd like to desensitize you with some tastefully animated Effect simulacra. This is an Effect, a recipe for some computation. Effects may succeed, or they may fail, either possibility will be evident at the type level. They'll even die for you, if necessary. You can turn promises into effects, and then combine them into larger programs, running one after another. If an Effect fails, you can retry it on a schedule.

wordTimings.definition: Representations or imitations of something. Here, visual animations that mimic how Effects behave.
